CustomField.description: Indicates whether this contact has pending enrichment suggestions that need review. Workflow/state field maintained by the Contact Enrichment solution.
CustomField.formula: IF(Pending_Enrichment_Count__c > 0, "Review Needed", IF(ISBLANK(Last_Enrichment_Check__c), "Not Checked", "Up to Date" ) )
CustomField.label: Enrichment Status
